## Download

| Computer | File | What to do |
|---|---|---|
| **Mac** (Apple Silicon M1/M2/M3/M4) | `PC Bridge.dmg` | Open it, drag PC Bridge to Applications, then **right-click → Open** the first time |
| **Windows PC** | `PC Bridge Setup.exe` | Run it. If Windows shows "Windows protected your PC", click **More info → Run anyway** |

Set up the **PC first**, then the Mac — each app has a step-by-step wizard.
Full beginner guide: [docs/GUIDE.md](https://github.com/walidriachy/pc-gpu-bridge/blob/main/docs/GUIDE.md)

These apps are not code-signed (that costs money each year), which is why macOS and Windows warn you the first time.
